# Frozen v1 fixture

`v1-custom.slpc` contains 15 synthetic inputs generated by `make_fixtures()`
in `../test_archive.py`; it contains no collected replays or user data.
The payload was frozen at commit `b66dd55`. Only its six-byte container header
was normalized to `SLPC`, version 1, flags 1; the compressed payload is unchanged.

The fixtures cover valid and older Slippi records, exceptional float bits,
empty/opaque/truncated input, unused/zero-width declarations, cross-file pools,
and opaque single-frame and chunked PowerPC payloads.

The test suite decodes this fixed archive and compares every byte against the
independently regenerated inputs. Keep the encoded payload fixed so decoder
changes remain checked against an independent encoder version.
